recon.notes: Platform confirmed by a working endpoint: the Wix Events warmup JSON (app 140603ad-af8d-84a5-2c80-a0f60cb47351) inline in /event-list and /, plus Wix's event-pages-sitemap.xml. The widget is upcoming-only (filterType 2) and hasMore=false, so 4 rows is the complete upcoming set; the homepage widget agrees. Run 20260909-072307 reported totalEvents 8, duplicatesRemoved 4, 4 kept: Weekend, Monster Ball, QUENCHD, Meat Market — the site lists Virgo Party II instead of QUENCHD, and QUENCHD is not linked from any configured page (see traps). Porky's sub-brand: 15 porkys-* slugs plus club-chub-porkys-presents-trick-or-trick-a-slutoween-party in the sitemap, all past; no Porky's event is upcoming. The Weekend page body contains the stale line 'September 11–13 2025' under a 2026 JSON-LD date (a copy-paste typo, see the event note). The Eventbrite organizer page is out of scope per the config comment and was not read.

coverage.basis: 4 upcoming events from the /event-list Wix Events warmup JSON (hasMore=false), confirmed by the identical homepage widget and the rendered DOM. Second door: event-pages-sitemap.xml lists 60 event pages all-time; all 60 were fetched and their JSON-LD dates read: 54 ended before 2026-09-10 (past, counted not enumerated; 16 of them are Porky's sub-brand pages), 4 are the widget's upcoming rows, and 2 are future-dated pages the widget hides — the-wig-out-party (renamed to Meat Market, same date/venue) and quenchd-a-mean-girls-pool-party (registration closed on Wix, unlisted) — both recorded as traps. Delta between sitemap and widget is therefore fully explained. Each of the 4 events was also read from its own /event-details page (JSON-LD + body text) and its flyer image was opened.
